newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan C.bank injects 2.0 mln dirhams at auction.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan C.bank injects 2.0 mln dirhams at auction.

text.p: Morocco's Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) injected 2.0 million dirhams in the money market for one week at its repurchase auction, a bank official said on Thursday.
"This week we injected a total two million dirhams in the money market," the official told Reuters but declined comment on the amount.

The bank received bids totalling 4.322 billion dirhams and allocated 3.772 billion dirhams at 6.5 percent interest rate. That was more than the 3.770 billion dirhams leaving the market this week, the official said.
It satisfied 87.27 percent of the demand for liquidity.
The next auction is due on March 19, 1997, the bank added.
